test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We have perhaps never seen an __ablest__ series of advocates than these ten standing in a row.
solution:
The correct answer is: **abler**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ablest" **is **incorrectly **used in the given sentence. The sentence is comparing the ability of advocates, so a **comparative form** should be used.
 
• Among the options, **"abler"** is the correct **comparative **form of "able".
 
• Option 1 "more able" is also a comparative form but "abler" is preferred in this context.
 
• Option 3 "the ablest" and option 4 "most ablest" are **superlative forms** and do not fit the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *We have perhaps never seen an **abler** series of advocates than these ten standing in a row*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Form:**

 
 
• Used to compare differences between two objects (larger, smaller, faster, higher).
 
• Example: She is** taller** than her brother.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Form:**
 
 
• Used to describe an object that is at the upper or lower limit of a quality (the tallest, the smallest, the fastest, the highest).
 
• Example: She is the** tallest** girl in the class.
